description: This file defines configuration structures, constants, and functions for the Ginkgo testing framework, including suite, reporter, CLI, and Go flags configurations, as well as functions to generate command-line arguments and validate configurations.

classes.name: SuiteConfig
classes.description: Configuration options for running individual test suites in Ginkgo.

classes.name: ReporterConfig
classes.description: Configuration for Ginkgo's test report output and verbosity.

classes.name: CLIConfig
classes.description: Configuration for the Ginkgo CLI commands such as build, run, and watch.

classes.name: GoFlagsConfig
classes.description: Configuration capturing Go build and run flags for analysis and profiling.

classes.name: deprecatedConfig
classes.description: Deprecated configuration options for Ginkgo version 2.0 and later.

methods.name: NewDefaultSuiteConfig
methods.description: Creates a default SuiteConfig with preset values.

methods.name: NewDefaultReporterConfig
methods.description: Creates a default ReporterConfig with preset values.

methods.name: NewDefaultCLIConfig
methods.description: Creates a default CLIConfig with preset values.

methods.name: NewDefaultGoFlagsConfig
methods.description: Creates a default GoFlagsConfig with preset values.

methods.name: BinaryMustBePreserved
methods.description: Determines if the binary must be preserved based on profiling flags.

methods.name: NeedsSymbols
methods.description: Checks if the binary needs symbols based on profiling flags.

methods.name: VetAndInitializeCLIAndGoConfig
methods.description: Validates and adjusts CLI and Go flags configurations for consistency.

methods.name: GenerateGoTestCompileArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for 'go test -c' to compile tests with profiling and coverage options.

methods.name: GenerateGinkgoTestRunArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for running Ginkgo tests with specified suite and reporter configurations.

methods.name: GenerateGoTestRunArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for running non-Ginkgo Go tests.

methods.name: BuildRunCommandFlagSet
methods.description: Builds the flag set for the 'ginkgo run' command.

methods.name: BuildWatchCommandFlagSet
methods.description: Builds the flag set for the 'ginkgo watch' command.

methods.name: BuildBuildCommandFlagSet
methods.description: Builds the flag set for the 'ginkgo build' command.

methods.name: BuildLabelsCommandFlagSet
methods.description: Builds the flag set for fetching labels from multiple suites.
